notes.title: Bug Fixes & Technical Update - Part 2
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42433959/df8ee934f2d904c74d85a5522cd297b7c8904857.png

While we continue to work in the background on the new character class and the new map, we have made some new bug fixes.

In this update we also improved the network performance in multiplayer mode and made some updates to the in-game graphics.

Visit us in our Discord for new ideas, feedback or bug reports - we always have an open ear and eye! 

Have fun mowing monsters!

Your ELEET GAMES Team

notes.title: Small Update to v0.235
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42433959/24e68443f94349a415de0fdf1e104fc76029db8f.png

Please update to latest version to avoid potential issues in multi-player sessions.

Patch Notes v0.235:
Leaderboards entries now update according to Difficulty level
Dark Knight ultimate shall now again be visible to all clients in MP 
Removal of info on controller moves in village , as we are not (officially) supporting controllers yet
Bugfix for negative amount of gold after char-purchase in tavern AFTER reset of perks at blacksmith
Edits regarding size of text windows in various spots to improve readability
